blocks.html: Morissette and Manila Philharmonic Orchestra Share the Stage This Christmas at Robinsons Malls

Get the best of both worlds this holiday season at Robinsons Malls! Enjoy a series of musical performances featuring the dazzling vocal styling of a certified birit queen, and the versatile repertoire of one of the country’s leading orchestras.

This December, award-winning vocalist Morissette shares the stage with the top-caliber Manila Philharmonic Orchestra, as Robinsons Malls offers shoppers a most unique way to celebrate the season. The shows will be held on December 1 at Robinsons Place Manila; December 8 at Robinsons Galleria; and December 15 at Robinsons Magnolia.

MORISSETTE
Much has changed from the time we first saw Morissette as a contestant on The Voice of the Philippines in 2013. Barely a year into the business, Morissette became a recording artist of Star Records and joined the cast of talented performers in ABS-CBN’s Sunday afternoon variety show, ASAP. As one of the show’s homegrown divas, she became part of the famous “birit queens.” Morissette’s songs are certified favorites among radio stations. She has a number of awards to her name, including New Female Recording Artist of the Year at the 7th PMPC Star Awards for Music.
“The Exceptional Morissette” makes Christmas merrier this season as she performs a mix of her original songs and all-time favorite tunes at a series of shows at Robinsons Malls.
Get ready to sing along to Morissette’s renditions of best-loved Christmas songs and some of today’s hits when she takes center stage at Robinsons Malls this December.

MANILA PHILHARMONIC ORCHESTRA
The Manila Philharmonic Orchestra is well-known here and abroad for its breadth of repertoire styles and its flexibility of size as a full symphony or chamber orchestra. After hundreds of well-applauded performances, MPO has succeeded in bringing music closer to various audiences. Behind MPO are some of the country’s best talents, who once had the privilege of performing alongside Italian tenor Andrea Bocelli in Manila, Hong Kong, and Singapore. This year marks MPO’s 20th anniversary.
Get in the spirit of the season when you listen to the Manila Philharmonic Orchestra perform songs like “Beethoven is Coming To Town,” “Winter Wonderland,” “Kumukuti-kutitap,” and more!

Don’t miss the delightful musical performances by the exceptional Morissette and the versatile Manila Philharmonic Orchestra at Robinsons Malls this December! Catch them live at Robinsons Place Manila on December 1; Robinsons Galleria-Ortigas on December 8 and Robinsons Magnolia on December 15. All shows start at 6 p.m.
